title: External Accuracy Packet to Runtime Contract Adapter Boundary Closeout

qualified_capability.purpose: Transport already validated, externally source-verified and canonicalized application-accuracy policy from an external runtime/coupler boundary into the canonical SWAP5 application-accuracy contract without parsing files or selecting policy.
required_attestations: application source digest content verified upstream against exact governed source bytes
temporal source digest content verified upstream against exact governed source bytes
qualified_capability.fail_closed_semantics: The output contract is initialized to its default unconfigured state before any validation. Any rejected input returns that default contract with materialized=false; only a fully valid candidate is copied to the output.
qualified_capability.policy_canonicalization_boundary: F-GC13 or another qualified external governance layer must canonicalize any externally governed direct temporal budget to H_app plus A_temporal before F-GC14. F-GC14 does not reinterpret policy modes.

qualification.first_failure_reason: Static source oracle matched the word JSON in a comment; executable source contained no format parser.
qualification.head_fraction_mapping: PASS: synthetic 8 cm x 0.25 = 2 cm temporal budget
qualification.drawdown_canonicalized_direct_budget_map: PASS: synthetic 10 cm x 0.2 = 2 cm temporal budget
qualification.nonfinite_guard_note: F-GC14 adds no fresh dynamic NaN/Inf test. It pins the previously qualified canonical application-contract blob, confirms its ieee_is_finite guards for H_app and A_temporal, and requires the F-GC14 materialization path to call those canonical validity methods before output publication.
